text:
Bitcoin consolidated around $76,500 after touching $79,000, absorbing $547 million in leveraged long liquidations. Institutional appetite remained resolute, with U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs securing nearly $1 billion in net inflows over a three-day streak led by BlackRock’s IBIT, pushing August cumulative ETF volume to 2026 highs.

Market focus has pivoted to the Federal Reserve’s Jackson Hole symposium on August 27–29, themed around financial innovation and digital payments. As Treasury bond buybacks compress long-dated yields and soften the U.S. dollar, risk-on capital continues to rotate across traditional equities and digital assets. Easing monetary conditions and resilient tech earnings are establishing a firm liquidity floor, tying crypto valuations closely to broader macro risk dynamics.
